columns.name: STAGING_ELEMENTS_ID
columns.description: Primary key.

columns.name: TRANSFERRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the associated definition has been either transferred via template or created manually by customer. We cannot re-run for any that have been transferred already.

columns.name: MIGRATE_DEFINITION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that the user wishes to transfer the earning.

columns.name: DEFINITION_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates if this is an earnings or deduction definition.

columns.name: SOURCE_ELEMENT_NAME
columns.description: Populated with whatever is considered the unique name of the earnings definition.

columns.name: SOURCE_ELEMENT_ID
columns.description: Will be populated with the identifier of the PeopleSoft source definition record.

columns.name: SOURCE_SHORT_DESC
columns.description: Value from PeopleSoft database. Not relevant for GPUK.

columns.name: SOURCE_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Value from PeopleSoft database.

columns.name: ELEMENT_NAME
columns.description:
Name of element to create on fusion.
(PAY_ELEMENT_TYPES_F.BASE_ELEMENT_NAME).

columns.name: ELEMENT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Primary key ID of element created (PAY_ELEMENT_TYPES_F.ELEMENT_TYPE_ID). This will be populated when the element is actually created on the Fusion system. It is intended to make it easy to map between the PeopleSoft and Fusion definitions.

columns.name: REPORTING_NAME
columns.description: The reporting name of the created element.

columns.name: LEGISLATIVE_DATA_GROUP_NAME
columns.description: Legislative data group name that element will belong to.

columns.name: LEGISLATIVE_DATA_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PER_LEGISLATIVE_DATA_GROUPS.

columns.name: PRIMARY_CLASSIFICATION_NAME
columns.description: Primary classification name that element will belong to.

columns.name: PRIMARY_CLASSIFICATION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PAY_ELE_CLASSIFICATIONS.CLASSIFICATION_ID (for a primary classification, i.e. where PAY_ELE_CLASSIFICATIONS.PARENT_CLASSIFICATION_ID is NULL).

columns.name: SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION_NAME
columns.description: Secondary classification name that element will belong to.

columns.name: SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PAY_ELE_CLASSIFICATIONS.CLASSIFICATION_ID.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of element to create on fusion.

columns.name: INPUT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Input currency for the element.

columns.name: OUTPUT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Output currency for the element.

columns.name: STANDARD_LINK_FLAG
columns.description: This sets the PAY_ELEMENT_TYPES_F.STANDARD_LINK_FLAG (which would also default PAY_ELEMENT_LINKS_F.STANDARD_LINK_FLAG).

columns.name: STARTING_TIME_DEF_SHORT_CODE
columns.description: Starting time definition short code value. Equivalent to PAY_TIME_DEFINITIONS.SHORT_NAME.

columns.name: STARTING_TIME_DEF_ID
columns.description: Foreign key reference to PAY_TIME_DEFINITIONS.TIME_DEFINITION_ID.

columns.name: ENDING_TIME_DEF_SHORT_CODE
columns.description: Ending time definition short code value. Equivalent to PAY_TIME_DEFINITIONS.SHORT_NAME.

columns.name: ENDING_TIME_DEF_ID
columns.description: Foreign key reference to PAY_TIME_DEFINITIONS.TIME_DEFINITION_ID.

columns.name: EMPLOYMENT_LEVEL
columns.description: Which level in three tier model will entries for this definition be attached.

columns.name: PROCESSING_TYPE
columns.description: Recurring (R) or non-recurring (N) definition.

columns.name: ONCE_EACH_PERIOD_FLAG
columns.description: Processed only once per period?

columns.name: MULTIPLE_ENTRIES_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.description: Whether or not more than one entry for this definition can exist over same span of time.

columns.name: INVOL_DEDUCTION_CODE
columns.description: The PeopleSoft involuntary deduction code. If set, indicates the definition is to be used for voluntary deduction mapping for a particular deduction type.

columns.name: PLAN_TYPE
columns.description: Required for PNA migration.

columns.name: DED_CLASS
columns.description: Required for PNA migration.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PER_ENTERPRISES.
